'''Mas Sirrah''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a member of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]].

==Biography==
===Hunting Jax Pavan===
{{Quote|I've never seen them travel together like that.”<br>”That makes me feel so much better.|I-5YQ and Den Dhur upon seeing Sirrah, Chael and Tesla|<ref name="CN3" />}}
[[File:Jax Pavan.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Jax Pavan, one of Sirrah's targets.]]
Following Inquisitor [[Probus Tesla|Probus Tesla’s]] [[Duel near Ploughtekal Market|battle]] with the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] boy [[Kajin Savaros]], Sirrah, a Human Corellian and [[Yral Chael]], was assigned to Tesla by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to help him try to find [[Jax Pavan]] and [[I-5YQ]]. Tesla was the nominal leader of the trio, though both Mas and Yral felt they should've been the leader as they thought Probus had already proven his weakness by almost getting [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a teenage boy. At the [[Ploughtekal Market]] Tesla, Chael and Sirrah inquired with a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] proprietor about if they had seen this boy. Eventually one of the Inquisitors lowered their cowl and looked down the street. Then the Inquisitor said something, the three Inquisitors got agitated and then the trio walked off into a life tube. When the former [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Den Dhur]] asked the proprietor about the Inquisitors, the proprietor seemed dazed and struggled to remember, leading Dhur to speculate that the Inquisitors had [[Memory rub/Legends|wiped]] some of the Sullustan’s memory.<ref name="CN3" />

The three continued until they came across the [[Snowblind Mews]], where Tesla [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] Savaros only for him to wink out, Sirrah and Chael failed to sense anything. Tesla expressed his frustration at Kajin’s presence disappearing, to which Chael reminded him that Jax and I-5YQ were their main targets and Savaros a secondary. Tesla argued that there was reason to believe that Jax was with Savaros. When Sirrah asked how Tesla could know that, Probus explained that the boy's power could’ve drawn Jax like how it drew him and Jax would probably want to recruit the boy. Probus then ordered Sirrah and Chael to stay in the area while he made a report to Vader so Chael and Mas slipped into the shadows.<ref name="CN3" />

[[File:Passelrots.jpg|thumb|right|250px|I-5YQ and Kajin Savaros used a Koorivar skinsuit to decieve the Inquisitors. (Kooirvar pictured)]]
Shortly after, Den Dhur and I-Five tried to return home to [[Poloda Place]] only for Den to spot an Inquisitor on a balcony. Den informed his droid companion of the truth officer and they retraced their steps so they could buy a [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]] skinsuit for I-Five as a disguise. They returned half an hour later, Dhur playing the part of a property agent and I-Five as his client. While they saw no Inquisitors at first, they soon spotted one in the shadow of an overhanging eave. Despite the uneasiness it brought Den, they got back into Poloda Place without issue.<ref name="CN3" />

Den and I-Five then came out shortly after with Kajin in the Koorivar skinsuit, bringing Kaj to an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] arranged by [[Haninum Tyk Rhinann]]. They were trying to move Kaj to the old studio of the late [[Caamasi/Legends|Camassi]] [[Ves Volette]], so they could hide his Force-sensitivivity with Volette’s [[Light sculpture|light sculptures]]. Den and Kajin spotted an Inquisitor roughly in the same position as Den saw him before. Kajin began to get nervous and started trying to take off his skinsuit, thinking he’d have to fight and knowing he couldn’t fight with the suit on. Den tried to talk him out of taking it off and attempted to keep him calm while I-Five began to pilot the airspeeder off ground. The Inquisitor sensed Kaj’s panic and raised his hand toward the flying speeder, hesitated then reached again before swiveling his head and ran across the courtyard to the resiblock Den, I-Five and Kaj came from. He jumped onto the communal docking station, following the traces Jax Pavan was dropping to lure him away from Kajin. Pavan made his way to the midlevels of the Ploughtekal Market but no Inquisitioners surfaced.<ref name="CN3" />

Alongside Tesla and Chael, Sirrah returned to the Snowblind Mews the following day. Tyk Rhinann spotted two or three of them, he wasn’t certain how many. He suggested to Pavan over a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holo-projection]] that they abandon Poloda Place, which Jax agreed, leading them all to move into Volette's old studio permenantly.<ref name="CN3" />

===Battle at Rainbow Parkway and death===
Two days later, the [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] [[Dejah Duare]] and Rhinann had taken Kajin Savaros to a small market. While walking down the street Dejah thought she saw the reflection of an Inquisitor in the canted window of a storefront. Kajin used the Force to probe the area for an Inquisitors and was about to assure Dejah it was nothing when he sensed two Inquisitors behind them, Sirrah and Chael, on the same street behind a corner and another Inquisitor, Probus Tesla, ahead of them, above and a half block away, but moving ever closer. Tesla was specifically seeking Kaj out, Savaros realized. The Inquisitors felt Kajin's minute use of the Force. Kajin instructed Dejah and Rhinann to get to a [[Cafe/Legends|cafe]] three doors down and ordered them to blend in with the mass there. Once they left, Kajin fell in pace in the shadow of a slow moving hovertruck. [[Laranth Tarak]], a [[Gray Paladin]], then stepped out of the cafe and fell in pace beside the boy. Kaj told her that there were Inquisitors. Laranth replied she could sense them. Kaj told her there was one above them as well, when Probus dropped down from above. Kajin was astounded to see him as he thought he had killed the Inquisitor in their earlier confrontation. The Paladin opened fire on Tesla with her [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] while Kajin released a [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force blast]] that sent Probus back a dozen meters. Tesla’s changed position caused Laranth to miss and hit the cargo compartment of the hovertruck, bursting it into flames, Someone then yelled and the whole street burst into chaos.<ref name="CN3" />

[[File:Streets of Shadows.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Mas came close to killing Laranth Tarak.]]
Jax Pavan sensed the [[Duel at Rainbow Parkway and Gallery Row|battle]] and went to the [[Gallery Row]] and saw that in [[Rainbow Parkway]] there were blasts of Force energy from multiple Force-sensitives. Sector [[Prefect/Legends|Prefect]] [[Pol Haus]], who was visiting to speak with Jax and I-Five, took them to the battle and offered to inform Imperials to not send back up as the Inquisitors had control of the situation. Jax and I-Five then left the prefect’s airspeeder and headed for the street. Chael and Sirrah prowled around Kajin’s [[Force barrier/Legends|Force shield]] that encased him and Laranth. When the shield lowered, Kajin [[Force jump/Legends|leapt]] up and Laranth dashed after Sirrah. By the time Chael had gotten himself on top of an eave above Jax, Laranth had lost Sirrah and was craning her neck trying to find him. Laranth didn’t see Sirrah emerge from the debris of the apothecary facade which had crumbled while Kajin fought Probus. She was spinning around to warn Jax about Chael’s position, leaving her flank open. The split second after Jax heard Chael’s yells from severing his leg, he heard Laranth open fire on Sirrah, who evaded her shot, blocked another with his [[Mas Sirrah's lightsaber|lightsaber]] and vaulted back into the street. A large chunk of masonry rolled from the top of the rubble which hid Sirrah from view. After Jax killed Yral he realized Tarak’s presence in the Force was absent and pivoted to where she had been, only to be filled with relief to see her running toward him and I-Five. However, Sirrah had moved since going to ground and was filled with fury at Yral’s death. Mas freed himself from the rubble using the Force and fell on the Gray Paladin from above the sidewalk, aiming one bolt of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force Lightning]] at her unprotected back, and a second at Jax and I-Five. Jax leapt to angle himself above the lightning to protect Tarak but even as he made the jump, he knew he’d be too late. Kajin Savaros, who had found Tesla underneath the debris, realized that Sirrah, not two meters away, who had been under a duracrete barrow had freed himself and was hurling lightning at the droid and two Jedi. He had to make a choice to save Laranth or make certain Tesla was dead this time, he decided on the former. Savaros used a Force push on Sirrah from every angle, crushing and atomizing him, leaving him as nothing more but ash which was tugged apart by the air current above the street only seconds later. One moment he was there, the next he was gone. Laranth had half fallen against a slab and masonry and looked up at the air while Jax and I-Five ran to her side. Kajin gave a sigh of relief.<ref name="CN3" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|You felt nothing when Mas Sirrah was taken?”<br>”Nothing. It was as if he had been… erased.”<br>”And you are certain this other phenomenon-this Force echo or reflection you spoke of-was the droid?”<br>”As certain as I can be.|Darth Vader and Probus Tesla|<ref name="CN3" />}}
Probus Tesla escaped and noted that the way Sirrah died was nothing like he had ever seen during his time as an Inquisitor. Adding that when Sirrah died there was no death echo and no echo of his Force signature almost as if he had never existed. Even Vader was left bewildered at how Mas died when he received the report from Tesla.<ref name="CN3" />

==Personality and traits==
Mas Sirrah believed he should’ve been the leader of the Inquisitor group consisting of him, Yral Chael and Probus Tesla instead of Tesla, as Tesla had failed to kill the teenager, Kajin Savaros. At Chael’s death, Sirrah was enveloped in fury.<ref name="CN3" />

==Powers and abilities==
Mas Sirrah was Force-sensitive. The erstwhile journalist Den Dhur speculated that Sirrah, Yral Chael and Probus Tesla had wiped a Sullustan proprietor’s memory of parts of their inquiry. Sirrah was unable to sense Kajin Savaros’s breakdown while fellow Inquisitor Probus Tesla could. Sirrah was capable of wielding Force Lightning and was able to free himself with the Force by thrusting rubble away after being buried under it.<ref name="CN3" />

==Equipment==
Mas Sirrah wore a cowl, wore a cloak and wielded a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. He, like other Inquisitors, also made use of a [[taozin amulet]] that hid his presence in the Force, making him appear as nothing.<ref name="CN3" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mas Sirrah first appeared in ''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]].''<ref name="CN3" />

Once Mas Sirrah and Yral Chael join Probus Tesla in Patterns of Force, Den and I-Five begin to spot Inquisitors. It is not made clear which Inquisitors they see, whether it is Tesla, Chael or Sirrah. This article includes those sightings that Den and I-Five have, but keeps which ones they are ambiguous, such as the book.<ref name="CN3" />
